Name: Shrublord's Stardew Forage Addon
Author: shrublord47
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=6]Shrublord's Stardew Forage Addon[/size][/font]
﻿
This is the first mod in a row to come (Shrublord's Stardew Additions), which is an addition of really whatever I feel like adding to the game.﻿

[font=Georgia][size=4]Forage Pack
[/size][/font]This Mod specifically adds 16 different forageables to the game, spread over the seasons and maps.

[font=Georgia][size=4]Requirements[/size][/font]
Farm Type Manager
Content Patcher

[font=Georgia][size=4]Languages[/size][/font]
Currently only English, but a German translation will follow soon.[/center][size=3]
[/size][center][font=Georgia][size=4]Content
[/size][/font][spoiler]
All seasons (except Winter): Daisy, Chickweed
Spring: Wild Garlic, Violet, Gentian, Rhododendron, Oyster Mushroom
Summer: Rapeseed, Shaggy Inkcap, Rhododendron, Gooseberry
Fall: Porcini, Black Trumpet Mushroom, Autumn Crocus, Sweet Chestnut
Winter: Whitebeam Pome, Juniper Berry
[/spoiler]﻿[/center]
